notes: Reference date 2018-02-25. Governing documents: the Provost's Policy on Faculty Family Leave (dated September 1, 2006; capture 2018-01-29) and the Faculty Handbook (last updated June 8, 2016; in force 2016-09-30 to 2018-10-18 per its version note), both in force on the reference date; the Policy on Extending the Probationary Period (May 2013). The Faculty FMLA FAQs page describes itself as 'additional interpretative guidance' (summary); the Faculty Leaves page is an index/navigation page with summary statements.

Calendar: the handbook refers to 'the nonteaching quarter' and 'three academic quarters'; Northwestern runs on quarters, so calendar.kind = quarter, and the term length follows R8's order. The family-leave 'academic term' is a quarter.

Main-campus scope: the family-leave policy sets the length by school. WCAS (arts and sciences) and McCormick (engineering), with SESP, SoC, Medill, Bienen and Kellogg (KSM), get one academic term (c1, c2: main campus under V3, faculty_scope recorded). Law School and Feinberg School of Medicine get ten weeks (c3-c6), recorded with faculty_group naming the school (V3b), not counted.

Relief (judgment, R4b/R4c): the family leaves relieve teaching ('corresponding reduction in teaching load') and University service, and the faculty member retains supervision of student research; research is not named. Coded as paid leave that keeps research (R4c; the GWU example in the rule), so its category is 'Just teaching' and it does not count in protected weeks (U3). The handbook's family-leave paragraph says the leave applies when the event 'necessitates cessation of active service', which could be read as a full leave (All duties); the policy's specific 'Expectations' paragraph was preferred.
Pay level of the family leaves: 'Paid leave' with no level stated; flagged R3 (full pay inferred).

Six-week 'Leave for Childbearing' (c7): the 2016 handbook makes it the benefit for instructional faculty who do not meet the family-leave eligibility. The 2006 policy says the term-long childbearing leave 'is not taken in addition to (but is coordinated with)' the six-week leave, so for tenure-stream faculty it adds nothing beyond c1; c7 is recorded for its group, not linked.

Birth parent chain (main campus): childbearing leave, one term (in the birth term or the next) -> childrearing leave, one term (on request, generally granted, within 12 months) -> unpaid FMLA 12 weeks 'in addition'. Medical leave for pregnancy-related disability (c8, up to 6 months, paid at budgeted salary by c9 within it) may fall before or after the childbearing term (also_available with c1; bed rest before the birth ends when childbearing leave begins); the summer-medical-leave teaching release (c10) follows a summer medical leave (consecutive_after c8).

Non-birth parent chain (main campus): childrearing leave, one term (equal-partner condition; starts at once, since the link to the birth parent's childbearing leave is ignored for this role) -> unpaid FMLA 12 weeks.

FMLA placement (judgment, S1 exception): the policy says 'Unpaid FMLA leave may be taken in addition to the leaves described below' and the family leaves 'are independent of' FMLA leave; the FAQ says faculty 'also may be eligible for additional unpaid FMLA leave'. The handbook says FMLA leave 'should be coordinated with' the family leaves. Coded consecutive_after c1 and c2, flagged ambiguous.

Not components: academic leaves of absence (scholarship, faculty development); the renewable non-salaried leave to explore a new career; leave without pay for military service; phased retirement (age 55+, 15 years' service); dependent-care travel grant, dependent-care FSA matching, child-care referral and school tuition discounts (not leave); medical leave/fitness-for-duty procedures (performance or threat evaluation). The general probationary-period extension for non-parental circumstances (personal or family emergencies, research problems) is part of the same policy; its parental terms are coded in c15-c16.

Use limits: 'One paid childbearing leave is available per birth or adoption event' renews with each birth (U9: not a limit; not recorded). Tenure-clock extensions are limited to two one-year extensions in all (use_limit on c15, c16).
